items.q: Is a QuickSign signature legally valid?
items.a: QuickSign produces a simple electronic signature. Its evidential value relies on traceability: timestamp, digital fingerprint of the document, audit log and signature certificate. It is suitable for the vast majority of everyday documents (contracts, certificates, letters). Some deeds require a specific form (notarial deeds, certain administrative acts): if in doubt, check with a legal professional.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to create an account?
items.a: No. The account is free and needs no card: you can explore the app, import a document and prepare your signature. A subscription is required to sign and export.
With MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money (through pawaPay), or a Visa / Mastercard card (through Paddle), our secure payment partners. QuickSign never sees or stores your payment details.

The dashboard, your profile, the editor with one imported document and one signature, and a few questions to the assistant. Final signing, signed PDF export and advanced features require a subscription. If a subscription ends, your documents stay viewable and downloadable: nothing is deleted.

Your documents are stored privately and encrypted, and are only reachable through temporary links. Nobody but you (and the people you invite) can see them. The AI assistant only reads a document when you ask it to.

items.q: Can I sign from my phone?
items.a: Yes. QuickSign is designed for phones first: import, sign with your finger and send, even on a slow connection.
Yes. .doc and .docx files are automatically converted to a PDF faithful to the original, which you can then sign. The original Word file is kept.

items.q: Do the people I ask to sign need an account?
items.a: No. With the Pro plan, they receive a secure link via WhatsApp or email, read the document and sign in seconds, without signing up.

items.q: Can I change plans or cancel?
items.a: Yes, anytime from your workspace. Upgrading to Pro is immediate; a cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid.
